summary: CombinedX AB (publ) operates as an IT consulting company in Sweden and internationally. It offers digital business development and transformation, service design and customer experience, business systems and business processes, data analysis and decision support, automation and robotization, application development and life cycle management, digital workplace and identity management, managed infrastructure services and security, Internet of Things and AI, and customer relationship management services. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Karlstad, Sweden.
